stepNotes.1: Risk namespace (19 exports) over score.ts: assess(signals)->Assessment, fromSession(sessionID) replaying EventQuery + persisted diff, levelForScore/top/explain/render helpers, plus decodeSessionDiffJson/Value Zod decoders.
stepNotes.2: Scoring/heuristic module driving review prioritization not authorization; consumes two untrusted inputs (disk diff JSON, session events) both defended by parseJsonResult + Zod safeParse; worst case is conservative low-confidence output (confidence floor 0.1); no network/shell/persistence-writes.
stepNotes.3: Scores bounded [0,100] via Math.min and levelForScore monotonic; confidence clamped [0.1,0.99]; normalize fills optional fields deterministically; readiness precedence sensible; fromSession pairs tool.call/result via validationMap[callID]; isCrossModule fix documented inline.
stepNotes.4: assess is pure O(1) over normalized signals; fromSession is O(events) single pass with bounded accumulators; diffs() is one synchronous readFileSync + Zod parse (minor blocking, appropriate for CLI/TUI); no caching but stateless.
stepNotes.5: Strong cohesion: types, normalize, assess (pure), fromSession (impure aggregation), render clearly sectioned; assess/fromSession seam makes scoring independently testable; magic-number thresholds inline are a mild smell; clean @/ imports.
stepNotes.6: No TODO/empty-catch; catch(err) at 229 logs risk diff read failed and returns undefined (correct treat-as-missing); patch() skips +++/--- headers correctly; SECURITY_PATTERNS is classification signal not enforcement; recoveredSubagent and completionGate factors are well-documented recent additions.
stepNotes.7: 8 test files span unit (session/risk, permission/risk-classes), CLI, TUI sync, server route, visual, DRE graph; gaps are negative tests for diffs() read-fail and decodeSessionDiffJson malformed paths, validationFailed text-heuristic edge cases, and confidence boundary assertions.
stepNotes.8: No findings registered; no new Critical/High found; module is pure consumer with no trust-enforcement surface; observations (magic-number thresholds, sync readFileSync, heuristic edge cases) are quality notes not invariant violations.
stepNotes.9: AX_TEST_FILES for session/risk, permission/risk-classes, cli/risk-view, visual/risk-summary, server/session-risk plus core typecheck; full suite skipped per README; core-only module with no Desktop/SDK/native/script gates.
